entry.title: microsoft/microsoft-ui-xaml - Releases - 2026-11-17
entry.content:
WinUI 3 in WinAppSDK 2.7.0

WinUI 3 in Windows App SDK 2.7.0 includes fixes for input, text controls, styling, and windowing. It is available through the Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK 2.7.0 NuGet package.

Bug fixes

  • Fixed an input offset in DPI-aware apps when CompositionEngineType.System is selected.
  • Fixed the Text Cursor Indicator not appearing immediately when an empty TextBox or RichEditBox receives focus.
  • Fixed ContentDialog entrance animations not playing and MenuFlyout items incorrectly showing tooltips when XamlChangeId.OptimizeApplyStyles is enabled (microsoft/microsoft-ui-xaml#11257), plus first-chance exceptions in default ScrollBar templates when DefaultStyleOptimizations is enabled.
  • Fixed a crash when reading Window.DispatcherQueue from a background thread after the window's XAML thread shuts down.

For the full set of changes, see the Windows App SDK 2.7.0 release notes.

Try it out

  • Install the Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK 2.7.0 NuGet package.
